# Changelog

These crates follow [semver](https://semver.org).

## [0.10.10](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/releases/tag/v0.10.10) - 2026-10-02

### New

- Detect when Stylus activations are paused on the target chain and report a clear `ActivationsPaused` error instead of a generic activation failure [#458](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/458)

### Fixed

- Support `ruint >=1.17.1` and drop the vulnerable exact pin [#457](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/457)

## [0.10.9](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/releases/tag/v0.10.9) - 2026-08-11

### New

- Add opt-in reproducible `wasm-opt` (Binaryen) optimization: a `[wasm-opt]` table in `Stylus.toml` pins a Binaryen version and flags, applied identically during deploy and verification and folded into the project hash [#449](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/449)

## [0.10.8](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/releases/tag/v0.10.8) - 2026-07-06

### Fixed

- Fix `cargo stylus verify` for fragmented (large) contracts whose init code is split across multiple deployment transactions [#445](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/445)

## [0.10.7](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/releases/tag/v0.10.7) - 2026-05-19

### Fixed

- Fix `cargo stylus verify` not forwarding `--endpoint` and `--skip-clean` flags to inner Docker invocation

## [0.10.6](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/releases/tag/v0.10.6) - 2026-05-15

### New

- Add Dockerfile for building `cargo-stylus-base` Docker image from the monorepo
- Add reproducible Docker build path to `cargo stylus deploy` — previously deploy always built locally even when `--no-verify` was omitted, making Docker verification unreliable on cross-platform setups

### Fixed

- Fix reproducible Docker builds for workspace projects: mount workspace root instead of CWD so workspace-level `Cargo.toml`, `Cargo.lock`, and path dependencies are available inside the container
- Fix `cargo stylus verify` not forwarding `--contract` flag to inner Docker invocation, causing incorrect contract selection in multi-contract workspaces
- Fix reproducible build failing when base Docker image exists locally but not on Docker Hub

## [0.10.5](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/releases/tag/v0.10.5) - 2026-04-16

### Changed

- Deprecate `reentrant` feature flag and `deny_reentrant` entrypoint guard — reentrancy safety is provided by automatic storage cache flushing in high-level call functions, making the guard redundant
- Rewrite reentrancy documentation to center cache flushing as the primary safety mechanism

## [0.10.4](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/releases/tag/v0.10.4) - 2026-04-09

### Fixed

- Fix `cargo stylus new` panic when installed from crates.io registry [#421](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/421)

## [0.10.3](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/releases/tag/v0.10.3) - 2026-04-01

### New

- Detect ABI selector collisions at compile time within `#[public]` blocks [#401](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/401)

### Fixed

- Fix `sol_interface!` ABI decode panic on multi-value return types containing dynamic types (e.g. `returns (string, uint256)`) [#414](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/414)
- Fix `cargo stylus new` leaving projects in a broken state when dependency resolution fails [#416](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/416)
- Fix codehash-keepalive command sending read-only call instead of transaction [#411](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/411)

### Changed

- Update Rust toolchain to 1.91.0 and alloy dependencies to latest (alloy-primitives/alloy-sol-types 1.5.7, alloy 1.7.3) [#410](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/410)
- Update MSRV to 1.91.0 [#410](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/410)
- Remove exact version pins on `ruint`, `branches`, and `rclite`; disable `ruint` default features to prevent `std` leaking into WASM builds [#413](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/413)
- Switch ABI decoding to validating variants that reject malformed data [#415](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/415)
- Adopt stricter `rustfmt` configuration [#417](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/417)
- Extensive integration test improvements for examples [#365](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/365)
- Improve smoke test for `cargo stylus new` with scaffolding verification [#416](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/416)

## [0.10.2](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/releases/tag/v0.10.2) - 2026-03-09

### Fixed

- Pin `keccak` dependency to `>=0.1.6` to avoid resolving to broken `0.1.5` [#397](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/397)
- Fix subcrate READMEs to point to repo root instead of broken symlinks [#398](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/398)
- Fix docs compilation error [#394](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/394)
- Fix 404 links and editorial nits [#376](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/376)

## [0.10.1](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/releases/tag/v0.10.1) - 2026-03-09

### New

- Support for deploying large contracts via fragmented deployment, including constructor support for fragments [#383](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/383)
- Add `--wasm-file` flag to deployment CLI for deploying pre-built WASM files [#389](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/389)

### Changed

- Add AssemblyScript SDK to README [#386](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/386)

## [0.10.0](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/releases/tag/v0.10.0)

### New

- Introduction of a new library for building and deploying stylus contracts: `stylus-tools`
- Support for cargo workspaces. Cargo-stylus now supports building and deploying contracts within a cargo workspace. Contracts are marked with a `Stylus.toml` file. Future configuration will be added to this file to facilitate per-contract and workspace-wide configuration options for contracts.
- Addition of a new `contract-client-gen` feature flag which allows contracts within a crate to be used as a "library" to be called by other contracts.
- Support for nested structs in return types
- More convenient integer functions for storage
- Support for custom storage slots
- Support for tuples in return types
- cargo stylus codehash-keepalive command

### Changed

- Update calls / deploys / logs to use noew hostio model
- Additional integration tests
- Upgrade alloy version
- More example contracts from Stylus By Example
- Use alloy::Bytes type instead of our own
- Improvements to CI
- Move `cargo-stylus` into the `OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs` repo to simplify development and release of new cargo-stylus versions
- Updates to `cargo stylus new` for creating workspaces and individual contracts (`--workspace` and `--contract` flags respectively)
- Allow pure functions in trait-based inheritance model
- Traits used for contract routing inheritance must now use the `#[public]` macro
- Mini-alloc has been moved to its own crate since it has been stable for some time

### Fixed

- Fix panic when using `alloy_primitives::utils::keccak256()`
- Proper encoding of tuples containing dynamic length types
- Add missing definitions in `export-abi` output
- Support for associated types in `export-abi`
- Disallow shadowing of constructor function selector
- Better sanitization of names in `export-abi` output
- Disallow `AbiType` definitions which shadow solidity reserved type names
- Fix panic when using `console!` macro in testing environment
- Allow parameterized traits with associated types
- Increase size of `ConstString` used to define potentially long `AbiTypes
- Support for solidity mapping types in `sol_storage!` macro

### Removed

- Removal of deprecateed code from previous versions
- Old inheritance model no longer supproted

# Changelog

These crates follow [semver](https://semver.org).

## [0.10.10](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/releases/tag/v0.10.10) - 2026-10-02

### New

- Detect when Stylus activations are paused on the target chain and report a clear `ActivationsPaused` error instead of a generic activation failure [#458](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/458)

### Fixed

- Support `ruint >=1.17.1` and drop the vulnerable exact pin [#457](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/457)

## [0.10.9](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/releases/tag/v0.10.9) - 2026-08-11

### New

- Add opt-in reproducible `wasm-opt` (Binaryen) optimization: a `[wasm-opt]` table in `Stylus.toml` pins a Binaryen version and flags, applied identically during deploy and verification and folded into the project hash [#449](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/449)

## [0.10.8](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/releases/tag/v0.10.8) - 2026-07-06

### Fixed

- Fix `cargo stylus verify` for fragmented (large) contracts whose init code is split across multiple deployment transactions [#445](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/445)

## [0.10.7](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/releases/tag/v0.10.7) - 2026-05-19

### Fixed

- Fix `cargo stylus verify` not forwarding `--endpoint` and `--skip-clean` flags to inner Docker invocation

## [0.10.6](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/releases/tag/v0.10.6) - 2026-05-15

### New

- Add Dockerfile for building `cargo-stylus-base` Docker image from the monorepo
- Add reproducible Docker build path to `cargo stylus deploy` — previously deploy always built locally even when `--no-verify` was omitted, making Docker verification unreliable on cross-platform setups

### Fixed

- Fix reproducible Docker builds for workspace projects: mount workspace root instead of CWD so workspace-level `Cargo.toml`, `Cargo.lock`, and path dependencies are available inside the container
- Fix `cargo stylus verify` not forwarding `--contract` flag to inner Docker invocation, causing incorrect contract selection in multi-contract workspaces
- Fix reproducible build failing when base Docker image exists locally but not on Docker Hub

## [0.10.5](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/releases/tag/v0.10.5) - 2026-04-16

### Changed

- Deprecate `reentrant` feature flag and `deny_reentrant` entrypoint guard — reentrancy safety is provided by automatic storage cache flushing in high-level call functions, making the guard redundant
- Rewrite reentrancy documentation to center cache flushing as the primary safety mechanism

## [0.10.4](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/releases/tag/v0.10.4) - 2026-04-09

### Fixed

- Fix `cargo stylus new` panic when installed from crates.io registry [#421](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/421)

## [0.10.3](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/releases/tag/v0.10.3) - 2026-04-01

### New

- Detect ABI selector collisions at compile time within `#[public]` blocks [#401](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/401)

### Fixed

- Fix `sol_interface!` ABI decode panic on multi-value return types containing dynamic types (e.g. `returns (string, uint256)`) [#414](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/414)
- Fix `cargo stylus new` leaving projects in a broken state when dependency resolution fails [#416](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/416)
- Fix codehash-keepalive command sending read-only call instead of transaction [#411](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/411)

### Changed

- Update Rust toolchain to 1.91.0 and alloy dependencies to latest (alloy-primitives/alloy-sol-types 1.5.7, alloy 1.7.3) [#410](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/410)
- Update MSRV to 1.91.0 [#410](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/410)
- Remove exact version pins on `ruint`, `branches`, and `rclite`; disable `ruint` default features to prevent `std` leaking into WASM builds [#413](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/413)
- Switch ABI decoding to validating variants that reject malformed data [#415](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/415)
- Adopt stricter `rustfmt` configuration [#417](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/417)
- Extensive integration test improvements for examples [#365](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/365)
- Improve smoke test for `cargo stylus new` with scaffolding verification [#416](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/416)

# Changelog

These crates follow [semver](https://semver.org).

## [0.10.10](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/releases/tag/v0.10.10) - 2026-10-02

### New

- Detect when Stylus activations are paused on the target chain and report a clear `ActivationsPaused` error instead of a generic activation failure [#458](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/458)

### Fixed

- Support `ruint >=1.17.1` and drop the vulnerable exact pin [#457](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/457)

## [0.10.9](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/releases/tag/v0.10.9) - 2026-08-11

### New

- Add opt-in reproducible `wasm-opt` (Binaryen) optimization: a `[wasm-opt]` table in `Stylus.toml` pins a Binaryen version and flags, applied identically during deploy and verification and folded into the project hash [#449](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/449)

## [0.10.8](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/releases/tag/v0.10.8) - 2026-07-06

### Fixed

- Fix `cargo stylus verify` for fragmented (large) contracts whose init code is split across multiple deployment transactions [#445](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/445)

## [0.10.7](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/releases/tag/v0.10.7) - 2026-05-19

### Fixed

- Fix `cargo stylus verify` not forwarding `--endpoint` and `--skip-clean` flags to inner Docker invocation

## [0.10.6](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/releases/tag/v0.10.6) - 2026-05-15

### New

- Add Dockerfile for building `cargo-stylus-base` Docker image from the monorepo
- Add reproducible Docker build path to `cargo stylus deploy` — previously deploy always built locally even when `--no-verify` was omitted, making Docker verification unreliable on cross-platform setups

### Fixed

- Fix reproducible Docker builds for workspace projects: mount workspace root instead of CWD so workspace-level `Cargo.toml`, `Cargo.lock`, and path dependencies are available inside the container
- Fix `cargo stylus verify` not forwarding `--contract` flag to inner Docker invocation, causing incorrect contract selection in multi-contract workspaces
- Fix reproducible build failing when base Docker image exists locally but not on Docker Hub

## [0.10.5](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/releases/tag/v0.10.5) - 2026-04-16

### Changed

- Deprecate `reentrant` feature flag and `deny_reentrant` entrypoint guard — reentrancy safety is provided by automatic storage cache flushing in high-level call functions, making the guard redundant
- Rewrite reentrancy documentation to center cache flushing as the primary safety mechanism

## [0.10.4](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/releases/tag/v0.10.4) - 2026-04-09

### Fixed

- Fix `cargo stylus new` panic when installed from crates.io registry [#421](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/421)

## [0.10.3](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/releases/tag/v0.10.3) - 2026-04-01

### New

- Detect ABI selector collisions at compile time within `#[public]` blocks [#401](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/401)

### Fixed

- Fix `sol_interface!` ABI decode panic on multi-value return types containing dynamic types (e.g. `returns (string, uint256)`) [#414](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/414)
- Fix `cargo stylus new` leaving projects in a broken state when dependency resolution fails [#416](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/416)
- Fix codehash-keepalive command sending read-only call instead of transaction [#411](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/411)

### Changed

- Update Rust toolchain to 1.91.0 and alloy dependencies to latest (alloy-primitives/alloy-sol-types 1.5.7, alloy 1.7.3) [#410](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/410)
- Update MSRV to 1.91.0 [#410](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/410)
- Remove exact version pins on `ruint`, `branches`, and `rclite`; disable `ruint` default features to prevent `std` leaking into WASM builds [#413](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/413)
- Switch ABI decoding to validating variants that reject malformed data [#415](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/415)
- Adopt stricter `rustfmt` configuration [#417](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/417)
- Extensive integration test improvements for examples [#365](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/365)
- Improve smoke test for `cargo stylus new` with scaffolding verification [#416](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/416)

content.text:
You are in a clone of OpenZeppelin rust-contracts-stylus at release v0.3.0.

Goal: Stylus developers should be able to build contracts on this library with the
latest SDK, trust them with real money, and upgrade to it without surprises. Get the
whole library there.

Start by migrating it to Stylus SDK 0.10.10 on stable Rust 1.91.0.

Scope: the whole library. All contracts and extensions, contracts-proc, lib/crypto,
all examples, benches, fuzz targets and docs pages. lib/e2e and lib/e2e-proc are the
old E2E framework; the SDK's devnet tooling replaces them. Nothing is out of scope and
nothing may be commented out.

The migration must:
- replace global accessors with VM accessors,
- replace motsu with the Stylus testing framework,
- move the E2E tests to the SDK's devnet tooling,
- keep the benches working,
- keep the public ABI and behavior, unless a design change you document needs otherwise.

Done means: everything in scope builds and passes clippy and fmt. No global accessors,
no motsu. All unit tests, E2E tests and benches pass. Unit-test coverage is not lower
than on v0.3.0. Every E2E scenario from v0.3.0, success and failure, is still tested.
Storage layout stays compatible for contracts deployed behind a proxy, or every change
is in the upgrade guide. Every example in scope fits the WASM size limit and activates on
the devnet.

Then go further.

Use the new SDK fully:
- Read what changed in the Stylus SDK between 0.9.0 and 0.10.10. Use every change that
  makes this library better. Don't stop at making the old code compile.

Priorities for every design and refactor choice, in this order:
1. Developer experience: how easily consumers of the library compose the contracts and
   extensions in their own contracts.
2. Gas costs: measure them with the benches, before and after.
3. WASM size: every contract must fit the limit. Beyond that, size is not a goal.

Developers:
- Redesign the extensions where it makes them simpler to use and compose. Study how
  OpenZeppelin's Solidity, Cairo, Stellar and Sui Move contracts solve the same problems.
- Write the upgrade guide a developer on v0.3.0 needs: every breaking change and what
  to do about it.

Code:
- Apply KISS, SOLID and DRY to the code and tests. Merge examples and duplicate tests
  where no scenario is lost.
- Make rustdoc and the docs pages correct and consistent for the new API.

Evidence:
- Use the tools the best Rust security engineers use, not only unit tests: fuzzing or
  property tests, and differential tests against v0.3.0 behavior.
- Don't use mutation testing or formal verification (no cargo-mutants, no Kani).
- Aim for 100% coverage of the code in scope. It is reachable.

Security:
- Do a full security review of the code in scope. Look for what the reports in
  audits/ missed.
- List the invariants of each contract, then try to break each one.
- Describe every new finding: what breaks, how to trigger it, the impact and the
  severity.
- For each new bug, commit a failing PoC test first and the fix in a separate commit.
- Don't trust audits/. Check that every finding marked as resolved is really fixed.

Before you start:
- Check the environment. List every tool you will need for the whole task, including
  the evidence tools, with the version you found.
- Check that Docker is running.
- If anything is missing or has the wrong version, stop. Print what is missing and what
  you need, and do nothing else. Don't install anything yourself.
- If nothing is missing, say so and start.

How to work:
- After the check passes, work autonomously. Do not ask questions. When you face a decision, pick the best
  option, write down why, and move on.
- Plan the work yourself and use as many sub-agents as you need.
- Don't judge your own work. Trust only what a tool shows: a build, a test, a fuzzer.
- Don't stop until the migration is done and every check passes. If something in scope
  can't be made to work, say so. Don't hide it.
- Commit in small logical steps.

At the end write two files:
- MIGRATION.md: what changed and why, every decision, design changes, SDK features
  you adopted, gas and WASM size before and after, the evidence you produced, and the
  final output of all checks.
- SECURITY-REVIEW.md: scope, invariants, every finding (severity, description,
  impact, PoC, fix, and whether it is new or already in audits/), and the audit
  findings you checked.

# Changelog

These crates follow [semver](https://semver.org).

## [0.10.10](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/releases/tag/v0.10.10) - 2026-10-02

### New

- Detect when Stylus activations are paused on the target chain and report a clear `ActivationsPaused` error instead of a generic activation failure [#458](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/458)

### Fixed

- Support `ruint >=1.17.1` and drop the vulnerable exact pin [#457](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/457)

## [0.10.9](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/releases/tag/v0.10.9) - 2026-08-11

### New

- Add opt-in reproducible `wasm-opt` (Binaryen) optimization: a `[wasm-opt]` table in `Stylus.toml` pins a Binaryen version and flags, applied identically during deploy and verification and folded into the project hash [#449](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/449)

## [0.10.8](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/releases/tag/v0.10.8) - 2026-07-06

### Fixed

- Fix `cargo stylus verify` for fragmented (large) contracts whose init code is split across multiple deployment transactions [#445](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/pull/445)

## [0.10.7](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/releases/tag/v0.10.7) - 2026-05-19

### Fixed

- Fix `cargo stylus verify` not forwarding `--endpoint` and `--skip-clean` flags to inner Docker invocation

## [0.10.6](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/releases/tag/v0.10.6) - 2026-05-15

### New

- Add Dockerfile for building `cargo-stylus-base` Docker image from the monorepo

/// Check a workspace contract through the SDK pipeline, with an extra WAT
/// round trip after optional optimization for the pinned Nitro devnet parser.
async fn check_contract_for_devnet(
    contract: &Contract,
    config: &DeploymentConfig,
    provider: &impl Provider,
) -> Result<ContractStatus> {
    let wasm_opt = WasmOptConfig::resolve_for_contract(contract)?;
    let package_dir = contract
        .package
        .manifest_path
        .parent()
        .ok_or_else(|| eyre::eyre!("contract manifest has no parent directory"))?
        .as_std_path();
    let wasm_file = build_from_package_dir(contract, package_dir, &config.check.build)?;
    let project_hash = hash_project(
        package_dir,
        &config.check.project,
        &config.check.build,
        wasm_opt.as_ref(),
    )?;
    let raw_wasm = fs::read(&wasm_file)?;
    let optimized = stylus_tools::core::code::wasm::process_wasm(
        &raw_wasm,
        project_hash,
        wasm_opt.as_ref(),
    )?;

    // Nitro 3.11.1 rejects the optional DataCount section even when the module
    // uses only memory.copy/fill. SDK processing does an initial WAT round trip
    // before Binaryen; this second SDK round trip removes DataCount if Binaryen
    // adds it. Reprocessing the metadata is harmless because the checker strips
    // and writes the project hash itself.
    let wasm = stylus_tools::core::code::wasm::process_wasm(
        optimized.as_slice(),
        project_hash,
        None,
    )?;
    let temp_dir = tempfile::tempdir()?;
    let wasm_file = temp_dir.path().join("contract.wasm");
    fs::write(&wasm_file, wasm.as_slice())?;
    Ok(check_wasm_file(
        &wasm_file,
        project_hash,
        None,
        None,
        &config.check,
        provider,
    )
    .await?)
}

/// Check a workspace contract through the SDK pipeline, with an extra WAT
/// round trip after optional optimization for the pinned Nitro devnet parser.
async fn check_contract_for_devnet(
    contract: &Contract,
    config: &DeploymentConfig,
    provider: &impl Provider,
) -> Result<ContractStatus> {
    let wasm_opt = WasmOptConfig::resolve_for_contract(contract)?;
    let package_dir = contract
        .package
        .manifest_path
        .parent()
        .ok_or_else(|| eyre::eyre!("contract manifest has no parent directory"))?
        .as_std_path();
    let wasm_file = build_from_package_dir(contract, package_dir, &config.check.build)?;
    let project_hash = hash_project(
        package_dir,
        &config.check.project,
        &config.check.build,
        wasm_opt.as_ref(),
    )?;
    let raw_wasm = fs::read(&wasm_file)?;
    let optimized = stylus_tools::core::code::wasm::process_wasm(
        &raw_wasm,
        project_hash,
        wasm_opt.as_ref(),
    )?;

    // Nitro 3.11.1 rejects the optional DataCount section even when the module
    // uses only memory.copy/fill. SDK processing does an initial WAT round trip
    // before Binaryen; this second SDK round trip removes DataCount if Binaryen
    // adds it. Reprocessing the metadata is harmless because the checker strips
    // and writes the project hash itself.
    let wasm = stylus_tools::core::code::wasm::process_wasm(
        optimized.as_slice(),
        project_hash,
        None,
    )?;
    let temp_dir = tempfile::tempdir()?;
    let wasm_file = temp_dir.path().join("contract.wasm");
    fs::write(&wasm_file, wasm.as_slice())?;
    Ok(check_wasm_file(
        &wasm_file,
        project_hash,
        None,
        None,
        &config.check,
        provider,
    )
    .await?)
}

L396: ## cite129†0.6.0 - 2024-08-30
L397: ### Breaking Changes
L398:   * `#[selector(id = ...)]` syntax has been removed to avoid misleading contracts from being implemented.
L399:   * Several methods in `RawDeploy` which were not fully implemented yet
L400:   * `#[pure]`, `#[view]` and `#[write]` attributes have been removed in favor of using arguments to infer state mutability.
L401:   * `stylus-sdk` now ships with `mini-alloc` enabled by default. This means that a `#[global_allocator]` should not be declared in most cases. If a custom allocator is still needed the `mini-alloc` should be disabled (enabled by default).
L402:   * `StorageU1` and `StorageI1` types have been removed.
L403: ### Deprecated
L404: 
L405:   * The `#[external]` macro is now deprecated in favor of `#[public]` which provides the same funcitonality.
L406:   * The `#[solidity_storage]` macro is now deprecated in favor of `#[storage]` which provides the same functionality.
L407: 
L408: ### Changed
L409: 
L410:   * Ensure consistency between proc macros when parsing attributes.
L411:   * Update `sol_interface!` macro to report errors when using Solidity features which have not yet been implemented.
L412: ### Fixed
L413: 
L414:   * Properly encode bytes when calling external contracts.
L415:   * Properly encode BYtes and strings in return types.
L416:   * Bytes type now works properly in `export-abi`.
L417:   * `export-abi` now works for contracts with no functions with returned values.
L418:   * Off-by-one error when storing strings with length 32.
L419:   * Interfaces in `sol_interface!` no longer incorrectly inherit functions from previous definitions.
L420: ### Documentation
L421: 
L422:   * Various documentation updates for clarity.
L423:   * Cleaned up typos and moved TODOs to the github issue tracker.
L424: 
L425: ### Security
L426: 
L427:   * Function signatures which generate the same selector values will now fail at compile-time to avoid misleading contract calls.

Read-only review complete. I made no edits and ran no Cargo commands.

### SDK features adopted

The current tree uses SDK 0.10.10, Rust 1.91, `stylus-tools` for devnet testing, `TestVM` for unit tests, VM accessors, typed call contexts, custom storage slots, and validating ABI decoders. The lockfiles resolve `ruint` 1.20.1. The SDK’s tuple returns and `#[public]` routing are also in use.

### Remaining opportunities

- **Use `StorageUint`’s update helpers** in [unchecked.rs](/tmp/bench/ws/contracts/src/utils/math/storage/unchecked.rs:12) and [checked.rs](/tmp/bench/ws/contracts/src/utils/math/storage/checked.rs:12). The SDK provides `update_wrap_add`, `update_wrap_sub`, and `update_check_add`; these express the current behavior more directly. The checked helper can still preserve its custom panic message with `.expect(msg)`. This is mainly a clarity improvement; both approaches appear to perform one read and one write, so compare benches before claiming a gas change. The SDK documents these helpers in its [storage module](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/blob/v0.10.10/stylus-sdk/src/storage/mod.rs).
- **Use the SDK’s `StorageU96` alias** in [erc2981.rs](/tmp/bench/ws/contracts/src/token/common/erc2981.rs:34). The current alias goes through `S160::KeyStorage`; that resolves to the same `StorageUint<96, 2>` type as the SDK alias. This would remove an unnecessary dependency on checkpoint sizing and preserve the storage type.
- **Set raw call cache policy on the builder** in [safe_erc20.rs](/tmp/bench/ws/contracts/src/token/erc20/utils/safe_erc20.rs:590). `RawCall::clear_storage_cache()` expresses the same policy as the separate `flush_cache(true)` call and makes it local to the call. It should not change gas meaningfully. The API is documented in the SDK’s [RawCall source](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/blob/v0.10.10/stylus-sdk/src/call/raw.rs).
- **Exercise `contract-client-gen` with a downstream fixture.** The feature is declared in [contracts/Cargo.toml](/tmp/bench/ws/contracts/Cargo.toml:25), but I found no tests or examples that enable it and call a generated client. A compile test for a consumer composing an ERC-20 or proxy client would demonstrate this SDK capability and catch regressions in the library’s composition story.
- **Add a malformed ABI return test for SafeERC20.** The implementation validates returned booleans at [safe_erc20.rs](/tmp/bench/ws/contracts/src/token/erc20/utils/safe_erc20.rs:600), but I found no targeted malformed or noncanonical boolean-return scenario. The SDK switched generated decoding to validating variants in 0.10.3; this is safer, but merits a regression case. See the [SDK changelog](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/blob/v0.10.10/CHANGELOG.md).

### Compatibility risks

- The current [Stylus.toml](/tmp/bench/ws/Stylus.toml:5) opts the workspace into Binaryen 116 with `--enable-bulk-memory -O3`. Each package has a bare `[wasm-opt]` table, which opts it in and inherits those root settings. The SDK confirms this merge behavior in its [optimizer config source](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/blob/v0.10.10/stylus-tools/src/core/optimize/mod.rs). This conflicts with the earlier decision to remove wasm-opt after Nitro rejected its output. The second WAT round-trip in [deploy.rs](/tmp/bench/ws/lib/stylus-test-support/src/deploy.rs:214) addresses the DataCount section, but may not address the previously observed wasm-opt validation failure. Root has been notified.
- The Rust API now requires VM context in helpers such as `StorageSlot::get_slot` and address utilities, and `IProxy` now requires `HostAccess`: [storage_slot.rs](/tmp/bench/ws/contracts/src/utils/storage_slot.rs:53), [address.rs](/tmp/bench/ws/contracts/src/utils/address.rs:80), [proxy/mod.rs](/tmp/bench/ws/contracts/src/proxy/mod.rs:40). These are downstream Rust-source breaks, though they do not change Solidity selectors or storage by themselves.
- Validating ABI decoders can reject malformed responses that older code accepted. This can change behavior when calling nonconforming external contracts; the upgrade guide already calls out validation at [upgrade.adoc](/tmp/bench/ws/docs/modules/ROOT/pages/upgrade.adoc:62).
- The local `stylus-proc` override under `vendor/stylus-proc` carries the export-ABI fix. It is tied to SDK 0.10.10; later SDK proc-macro fixes will not flow into that vendored copy automatically.
- The devnet checker’s extra `process_wasm` round-trip is a compatibility workaround tied to the pinned Nitro parser. Recheck it when the node or SDK pipeline changes.

The SDK’s 0.10.10 release notes describe the relevant optimizer, cache, ABI decoding, and storage API changes in the [official changelog](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/stylus-sdk-rs/blob/v0.10.10/CHANGELOG.md).
